Chapter 7116: Skykiller Dragon Servants

Chapter 7116: Skykiller Dragon Servants

Stone Immortal and the adult chongming birds wore serious expressions. Despite their high status, they have not received any news about their lord’s sealing.

The whole thing was hidden inside a black trunk, only available to the strongest divine beasts. Unfortunately, Li Qiye brought no useful news.

“Order Lord, may I ask what you are taking from the palace?” Stone Immortal bowed.

“I have to report it to you?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Of course not, you can take anything you wish.” He said.

“Very good, to the palace then.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Right away.” Stone Immortal agreed.

Logic dictated that they be more cautious toward this stranger bearing the order. However, they chose to obey the rule instead.

They brought him to the palace’s fortified entrance but were interrupted by warning gongs.

“What’s happening?” Everyone became alarmed and prepared for battle in the mortal world.

In the divine realm, emperors and above rushed toward the source.

“Reporting, the skykiller dragon servants are here.” A scout told the group.

“I see...” Even the chongming birds were alarmed.

Skykiller dragon servants were special, having authority all over Divine Firmament, not just their masters’ domain.

“Boom!” A cavalry appeared outside of Chong Firmament, pulsing with impressive radiance. This group consisted of only immortals, displaying the full might of Divine Firmament.

Just the divine beasts’ servants alone were immensely powerful.

“From Skykiller Palace...” Those from below looked up in awe.

“Stone Immortal, please open the gate.” An armored general’s voice echoed across Chong Firmament, forming a law capable of threatening immortals.

“Chief Immortal Guard.” Stone Immortal didn’t expect this man to come.

He has kept his role for a long time now and with the current lord’s permission, he could command all the other dragon servants.

“Why is he here?” The adult chongming birds wondered, feeling something ominous.

The chief guard’s primary role was to ensure the safety of Skykiller Palace. Since Chongming Bird was sealed, whose order was he following?

“Open or not?” Stone Immortal couldn’t decide: “Order Lord, what is your opinion?”

He somehow asked Li Qiye during this moment of uncertainty.

“I’m afraid this is the divine beasts’ internal matter, not any of my business. And even if you don’t open, they won’t let it go that easily.” Li Qiye smiled.

Those nearby agreed with this logic since the cavalry was here for a reason.

“Open.” An adult chongming bird spoke: “They will not dare to cause trouble here.”

These skykiller dragon servants might be powerful but ultimately, they were still servants to the divine beasts.
